summary: Phase 3 Sub-pass B verification. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_ubos_phase3b.py (18 tests) — all PASSED: media upload/dedup/thumb+serve, PDF SVG icon, SVG rejection, quota_exceeded 413, file_too_large 413, RBAC (viewer 403 / editor 201-204), image-field lifecycle + non-existent media 422 + PDF-in-image 422, file-field allowed_mimes 422, delete cascade with quota refund, relationship instances (one_to_one/one_to_many/many_to_many + cascade + unlink idempotent + viewer 403), storage-quota admin RBAC. Frontend Playwright verified: /media page renders (grid, storage bar 120MB/5GB, mime chips, search, drop zone), sidebar Media link enabled (no chip), upload adds tile, tile drawer shows Type/Size/Dimensions/Uploaded/Download/Delete/Used-in-N-records, /settings/organization Storage panel shows quota bar + editable MB input + Update + Manage in Media Library link, record detail page has all 5 tabs (Overview/Activity/Versions/Attachments/Relationships), Attachments tab renders drop zone + 'No attachments yet.' empty state, Relationships tab renders empty state with 'Define relationships in Entity Types → Rels first.' hint. QR payload now uses public preview URL (Phase 3-A action item from iteration 6 was fixed).

minor.issue: Response returns the full org doc with settings.storage_quota_bytes nested inside `settings`, not a flat storage_quota_bytes field at the top. Not a bug but worth aligning with the frontend expectation — the frontend does read settings.storage_quota_bytes, so this is only a doc-shape observation.
Thumb file is not removed from disk (comment in code acknowledges this as an orphan). Low priority.

issues: Duplicate 'COVER' and 'DOCS' fields appear because prior test runs (including ours) added image/file fields to the seed 'products' entity — consider a `_reset_acme` sweeper for image/file fields when running tests, or scope test fields to a fresh entity type. Not a functional bug.

action_items: None blocking. Optionally: (a) flatten the /orgs/:id/storage-quota response to include storage_quota_bytes at the top level for API consistency, (b) purge test-generated cover_* / docs_* fields from the seed Products entity to keep the UI Overview tidy, (c) sweep orphan .thumb.jpg files on cascade delete.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/media.py upload_media: multipart uploads read the ENTIRE file body into memory (await up.read()) before the size check — a hostile client can OOM the worker with a huge multipart body before quota_svc rejects. Consider streaming to disk with a size guard.

routes/media.py delete_media: cascade path only compares `media_id == mid` or `id == mid` for dict values, but PATCH creates entries as {'media_id': ...}. It also strips single-value fields to `None` but list-value fields to `[]` — verify frontend renderers accept both.

services/relationships.py link_records: cardinality for one_to_many when src_dir=='to' calls _count_links(src, rel_def_id, 'to') which is semantically identical to the from-side branch but reads confusingly — inline comment or refactor would help.

services/quota.py set_quota: no re-read after $set — relies on `return_document=True` boolean which pymongo accepts, but the returned doc is the AFTER version only when ReturnDocument.AFTER is imported; passing `True` currently works but is fragile.

routes/media.py serve_media: no auth check on the token endpoint — HMAC + 1h TTL is fine, but tokens are logged in access logs / referrer headers. Consider adding X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin headers.

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (POST /api/dev/seed-demo idempotent). Tests created ~20 media docs, several new entity_types (eta_/etb_/casa_/casb_/uxa_/uxb_/rba_/rbb_ prefixes) plus image/file fields on the products entity (cover_*, docs_*). Total storage after run ~120 MB used of 5 GB quota (fill-*.bin files from quota test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sub-pass B is verified end-to-end (18/18 backend, all critical UI flows). If Products Overview looks cluttered with dupe COVER/DOCS fields, that's leftover test-schema — safe to delete via DELETE /api/fields/{id}. The presigned /api/media/serve/{token} URLs come back as absolute in most paths but the /thumb endpoint returns a relative path — test suite prepends BASE. Frontend already handles both. Backend logs shows the audit action stream includes org.quota_updated, media.uploaded, media.attached, media.detached, media.deleted, record.linked, record.unlinked.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. All three test failures in the first run were test-code issues: (1) relative URL from /thumb needed BASE prepending, (2) quota test attempted a 100+MB upload which hit file_too_large before quota_exceeded — reworked to pre-fill quota then shrink to MIN, (3) storage-quota response uses nested settings.storage_quota_bytes rather than top-level. All three fixed in the test file, not in app code.
